template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of the source page (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.
notes: 700 x 1000 mm, no bleed in the source (page = trim), template adds 3 mm bleed. No hidden or off-page leftovers: all 72 source paths are on the page; the two paths that stick out (the navy field and the speech bubble) are kept in the reference. Navy field: one huge source path (956 x 1272 mm, a speech bubble of radius 527 mm centred at 350.8 / 364.4 whose pointer lies at the bottom), only the part on the page is visible. The template rebuilds the visible part as a path (source path intersected with the page plus bleed): the lower left is cut by the arc, white paper below it up to x 350.8, then a vertical edge, and a second white wedge at the bottom right where the pointer curve leaves the page. Library: logo and tagline are py-comp-tagline-lockup at scale 2.52 (beeldmerk 73.0 mm high, library 28.95 mm), top left at 58.7 / 58.1 mm. Texts are live Ubuntu in the source and in the template: Let op! Bold 111.9 mm, two body lines Medium 55.95 mm (baselines 54 mm apart), all white; price and label are rotated 6.71 degrees counter clockwise inside the speech bubble. Calendars: three py-atom-icon-calendar (pitch 175.85 mm) with centred navy date. In the source the first date (20 juni) sits 3.3 mm left of the centre of its calendar, the template centres all three. Colours: navy of the file #23398E (RGB ICC, drift) becomes the token #1A3580 in the template and in the library elements, the reference keeps the source value. The bubble light aqua #78C9DC has no token and is kept as sampled. Variables: headline, body-line-1, body-line-2, price, label, day-N, month-N, background-colour. Third party mark Live at Philips Stadium (bottom left, 48 to 235 mm) is reference only, source the official file. The template bubble shape is the source path cut at the bleed (it sticks out 9 mm at the top and right in the source).
